title: Delegation follow-up HTTP semantics: 200->202 + ApiError JSON rejection + route-level tests
outcome: Review (both): POST /api/sessions/{id}/delegations/{delegation_id}/followup returns 200 for an async turn acceptance (should be 202 like send_message) and uses the default Axum Json rejection instead of the project's ApiError JSON mapping. Add: return 202, map JsonRejection via api_json_rejection, and add route-level + tool_followup_session MCP tests (mirror delegation_mcp_send_to_session_posts_message_to_target). src/api.rs:725.
